name: usage-meter
description: Shows your account rate-limit windows (5h, 7d, spend) as a band above the prompt or a status line, toasts at warn and critical levels, and adds /limits.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where the meter shows: a band above the prompt, or a one-line status.

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: Toast once per window per reset period when usage reaches this percent.

critAt.title: Critical at (%)
critAt.description: Toast once per window per reset period when usage reaches this percent.
